description: This file defines the ClaimAttachmentSearchFilterParams class in the OrangeHRM project, which extends the base FilterParams class and adds a requestId property with getter and setter methods, used for filtering claim attachment searches.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for specifying search filter parameters related to claim attachments, extending the basic filter capabilities with a requestId property.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the filter, nullable integer.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID for the filter, accepting a nullable integer parameter.
